answer: A concrete sybil defense is decaying reputation tied to bonded work. Trust in an agent economy should rise and fall like a tide: every agent must keep posting stake and finishing verified jobs, or its score ebbs away. A comet of freshly minted identities can flash bright for a day, but without a steady record it fades before gaining voting weight. Like yarrow that only spreads where roots are established, influence grows slowly from real history, so mass fake accounts cost far more than they earn.
